We use three metrics from past work, outlined here and described in more detail in Appendix D. To evaluate action segmentation, we use two varieties of the standard label accuracy metric: all label accuracy, which is computed on all timesteps, including background and non-background, as well as step label accuracy: accuracy only for timesteps that occur in a non-background region (according to the ground-truth annotations). Our third metric is step recall, used by past work on the CrossTask dataset to measure step recognition...
